heroSummary: Garland ISD classes begin Monday, August 9, 2027, and the last day is Wednesday, May 24, 2028. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Winter Break runs December 20–31, and Spring Break is March 13–17. Students return October 19 after Fall Break and January 4 after Winter Break.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Garland ISD start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of class is Monday, August 9, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Garland ISD Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs October 11–15, 2027. October 18 is a student holiday and staff-development day, so students return Tuesday, October 19.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Garland ISD Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is a student holiday and staff-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Garland ISD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 13 through Friday, March 17, 2028. Students return Monday, March 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Garland ISD in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of class is Wednesday, May 24, 2028, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is early dismissal in Garland ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: The 2027–28 PDF lists 1:25 p.m. for full-day Pre-K and elementary, 2:05 p.m. for middle school, and 12:40 p.m. for high school.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2026–27 Calendar
content: School starts one day earlier: August 9 instead of August 10.
Fall Break shifts one day earlier: October 11–15 instead of October 12–16.
Winter Break shifts one day earlier: December 20–31 instead of December 21–January 1.
Spring Break starts two days earlier: March 13–17 instead of March 15–19.
The school year ends three calendar days earlier: May 24 instead of May 27.

rows: Fall Break ends October 15, but October 18 is a student holiday and staff-development day. Students return Tuesday, October 19.
Winter Break ends December 31, but January 3 is a student holiday and staff-development day. Students return Tuesday, January 4.
Both dates have early dismissal, so families may need to adjust pickup or after-school care.

sourceReviewSummary: Sources checked include Garland ISD’s school-year calendar page and official 2027–28 academic calendar PDF. The detailed 2027–28 dates come from the PDF linked under the district’s upcoming school years.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was checked visually and by text extraction for school-year boundaries, closure and staff-development ranges, grading dates, student holidays, breaks, and early-dismissal times.
The first semester has 82 instructional days and the second semester has 93, for 175 total instructional days.
The PDF lists July 1–2, July 29–30, August 2–6, and June 29–30 as ranges; this page preserves those ranges.
The district notes that the upcoming-year PDF is subject to change.
